news.title: Poke makes using AI agents as easy as sending a text
news.description: Poke brings AI agents to everyday users via text message by handling tasks and automations without complex setup, apps, or technical know-how.

news.title: AWS boss explains why investing billions in both Anthropic and OpenAI is an OK conflict
news.description: AWS has an ingrained culture of handling competition, he explained, because the cloud giant also competes with its partners.

news.title: Tubi is the first streamer to launch a native app within ChatGPT
news.description: Tubi becomes the first streaming service to offer an app integration within ChatGPT, the AI chatbot that millions of users turn to for answers.

news.title: Astropad’s Workbench reimagines remote desktop for AI agents, not IT support
news.description: Astropad’s Workbench lets users remotely monitor and control AI agents on Mac Minis from iPhone or iPad, with low-latency streaming and mobile access.

news.title: OpenAI releases a new safety blueprint to address the rise in child sexual exploitation
news.description: OpenAI's new Child Safety Blueprint aims to tackle the alarming rise in child sexual exploitation linked to advancements in AI.

news.title: OpenAI encourages firms to trial four-day weeks to adapt to AI era
news.description: The ChatGPT-maker said its early policy ideas aim to prompt discussions about action needed as AI systems become more capable.

news.title: Businesses scramble to get noticed by AI search
news.description: Firms are changing the way they present information on their websites, so they get noticed by AI.

news.title: This AI Wearable From Ex-Apple Engineers Looks Like an iPod Shuffle
news.description: Two former Apple Vision Pro developers made an AI wearable that only listens when you tap it. They hope to win where other AI gadgets have fumbled: privacy.
